title: Top Notcher
transcription:
Top Notcher
Action song

I points to myself "Vat is elast, here?"
Dist istmy — yah mammedic.
yah mammedic, that's vat I
learned in der school, boom-boom.

...Top Notcher, (head)
...Sweat Browser, (forehead)
...Eye Winker, (eye)
...Soup Strainer, (mustache)
...Lunch Eater, (mouth)
...Chin Chosser, (chin)
...Rubber Necker, (neck)
...Chest Protector, (chest)
...Bread Basket, (belly)
...Baby bouncer, (knee)
...Ball kicker, (foot)

This is a 'head, shoulders, knees and toes' type
song in which you point to the corresponding
part as you sing about it. Sing through all the
previous parts as you add new ones, adding
the yah mammedic - at the end of the list to
finish off the verse.
notes: Draft song-level split from visual page transcription. Source page note: Draft visual transcription; dialect spellings and small italic instructions are uncertain in places.
